title: Mechanical Engineer Manager
summary: Lead the mechanical engineering function, overseeing design, project delivery, engineering standards and team development.
description: Lead the mechanical engineering function, overseeing design, project delivery, engineering standards and team development.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Lead, mentor and manage mechanical engineers, performance, workloads and resources.
Review and approve mechanical designs, calculations and technical specifications against client requirements and industry codes.
Resolve technical issues during design, installation and commissioning and drive improvements.
Coordinate project managers, electrical engineers, site teams, clients and contractors.
Provide technical input, cost estimates and risk assessments for tenders and bids.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: Relevant mechanical engineering degree or qualification and leadership experience in construction, MEP or infrastructure.
In-depth knowledge of mechanical systems, codes, compliance and full-lifecycle delivery.
Unrestricted right to work in EU without sponsorship.

sections.heading: Key Competencies & Desirable Attributes
items: Mentoring, analytical and commercial judgement, communication and safety focus.
